change_from_v1: maneuver module has setpoint authority (ReferencePID.rpy_reference); T3 target 0.25 m / 4 s window; 8 tuning + 16 blind test cases; CEM elites must fly all tuning cases

tasks.nod: t_30 (|pitch| >= 30 deg held >= 0.1 s) + t_recover (to < 5 deg) + .03 dz_cm + .5 |drift_m| (+ crash 10 + 5 x unflown); miss = 2.5 s each
tasks.dash: t_reach (0.25 m) + t_settle + 2 overshoot_m (beyond 0.35 m) + .03 dz_cm + .5 |lateral_m| (+ crash); miss = 4 s (+2 x shortfall)

gate_S0: classical S1 (or S2) reaches a sustained 30 deg in >= 12/16 test cases (nod) and 0.25 m in >= 12/16 (dash); otherwise the task definition is revised before any learner is trained
headroom_rule: S2 or S3 beats S1 by >= 20 % on the 16 test cases -> learning room; the classical opponent for the composite benchmark is the better of S1/S2 on the TEST set only if it was selected on the TUNING set (it is)
